title: TT classification
description: Shape of a TT classification (TT-SPEC §4). This schema checks shape only — that ids exist in the cited bundle under the offered lens, that retired ids are refused with their successor named, and that abstention carries no mass are bundle-dependent checks the schema language cannot express; tt_validate.py performs them. Passing this schema is necessary, not sufficient.

bundle.description: The release that produced this reading, e.g. "tt-ontology/1.0 v2.1.0". Optional on input; the validator stamps it on output.

profile.description: Mass distribution over one lens: at most 3 entries, each mass in (0, 1]. Masses must additionally sum to at most 1.0 per lens, which JSON Schema cannot express.
